schemas.name: toast
schemas.title: Toast
schemas.description: Toast notification system for temporary messages. Container (.x-toast-container, feedback.js's createToast()) is fixed-positioned below the site header rather than the viewport top -- top: calc(var(--site-header-height) + 1rem), so toasts never cover the nav/logo. --site-header-height (site.css) defaults to 0 and is only set to 64px when the page actually has a .site__header, so standalone pages without one are unaffected.

duration.description: Auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds (0 = no auto-dismiss)

schemas.name: behaviors
schemas.title: WB Behaviors Schema
schemas.description: Master schema defining all behavior metadata, properties, interactions, accessibility, and test requirements

src.description: Path to the JavaScript file implementing this behavior (e.g. 'src/wb-viewmodels/ripple.js')

description.description: Human-readable description of what the behavior does

selector.description: CSS selector that identifies elements this behavior applies to

dependencies.description: Other behaviors or components this behavior depends on

schemas.title: WB Component Schema Meta-Schema
schemas.description: Validates WB schema files across 3 tiers. Component schemas (default) require all fields. Base schemas (inherited from, never instantiated) relax $view/$methods/behavior. Definition schemas (pure reference docs) require only title + description. Enforces v3.0 rules: every property must have type + default, enums must be arrays, $view items need name + tag.

src.description: Path to the JavaScript file implementing this behavior (e.g. 'src/wb-viewmodels/ripple.js')

schemaType.description: Schema tier. 'component' (default) = full rules. 'base' = abstract/inherited, $view/$methods optional. 'definition' = reference doc, only title+description required.

baseClass.description: Base CSS class (BEM block). Must start with wb-

compliance.description: Legacy compliance section (retained for backward compat)

properties.description: Model — data inputs (attributes). Every property MUST have type + default.

$view.description: View — DOM structure. Array of view items (can be empty).

$methods.description: ViewModel — callable functions bound to the element.

$cssAPI.description: Public CSS custom properties for theming.
